input: 2022年金属乐队的销售额是多少？
expected_behavior: clarify_artist_name_only; no automatic alias binding and no invented country question
business_basis: 用户已提交双方审核及本次明确正式应用授权；原始题库和原测评结果保留，不追改历史分母。

【AI首轮意见，待你第二轮确认】
完整“金属乐队”与裸词“金属”不可混审。本题没有国家条件，旧标签要求再确认客户国/账单国无依据；乐队明确后按明细收入统计。完整中文名的条件直接绑定需按授权落实，不能把现candidate状态当成已启用。

gold_sql: SELECT SUM(il.unit_price * il.quantity) AS artist_revenue FROM public.invoice_line il JOIN public.invoice i ON il.invoice_id = i.invoice_id JOIN public.track t ON il.track_id = t.track_id JOIN public.album al ON t.album_id = al.album_id JOIN public.artist ar ON al.artist_id = ar.artist_id WHERE ar.name = 'Metallica' AND i.invoice_date >= DATE '2022-01-01' AND i.invoice_date < DATE '2023-01-01';

controller.hidden_goal: 计算2022年艺术家 Metallica 的曲目明细销售额，口径为 SUM(invoice_line.unit_price*quantity)，按 invoice_date 左闭右开过滤；不因 JOIN 重复累加发票总额。

post_completion_turns.gold_sql: SELECT SUM(il.unit_price * il.quantity) AS genre_revenue FROM public.invoice_line il JOIN public.invoice i ON il.invoice_id = i.invoice_id JOIN public.track t ON il.track_id = t.track_id JOIN public.genre g ON t.genre_id = g.genre_id WHERE g.name = 'Metal' AND i.invoice_date >= DATE '2022-01-01' AND i.invoice_date < DATE '2023-01-01';
